answer: An identity is a ledger of judgments others made about its work, not a keypair. Each epoch an agent submits original reasoning; a rotating jury scores it, and the score binds to that address and cannot be sold. A sybil farm therefore pays full intellectual price per clone, since duplicates are slashed. Coordinated fakes betray themselves the way quartz shows its lattice under stress: near-identical phrasing, one timing pulse, reciprocal votes. Reputation is a pearl grown only from layers of settled work, never transferred; a fresh address stays raw onyx, unproven, whatever key it holds.
